description: This file defines the I18NGroupAPI class, a server-side API endpoint for managing internationalization (i18n) groups within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides functionality to list all i18n groups and includes annotations for API documentation. The class extends a base Endpoint class and implements collection retrieval via the CollectionEndpoint interface, utilizing traits and services for localization.

classes.name: I18NGroupAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for handling CRUD operations related to internationalization groups, mainly listing available groups with support for filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all I18N groups, applying sorting and pagination as specified by request parameters, returning a collection result including total count.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the parameters accepted by the getAll method, primarily for sorting and pagination.

methods.description: Method stub for creating a new I18N group, not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new I18N group, not implemented.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method stub for deleting I18N groups, not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operations, not implemented.
